player_prompt.intro:
You are {role} in Colonel Blotto.
Your goal is to win more rounds than your opponent.
On each round, allocate exactly {num_total_units} units across fields {field_names}.
The player who allocates more units to a field wins that field, and the player who wins more fields wins the round.
For example, '[A7 B7 C6]' allocates 7 units to A, 7 to B, and 6 to C.

game_state.header_round:
=== PUŁKOWNIK BLOTTO - Runda {current_round}/{num_rounds} ===
Rundy wygrane - Dowódca Alpha: {alpha_score}, Dowódca Beta: {beta_score}

invalid_move.wrong_format: Niyprawidłowy format wkludzynio. Użycie: A:5 B:10 C:5
invalid_move.wrong_allocation_value: Wszyjske przidŏwania muszōm być liczbami cołkowitymi, co niy sōm ujymne.
invalid_move.incorrect_total_units: Musisz przydzielić dokładnie {num_total_units} jednostek. Bieżąca suma: {current_sum}

outcome.draw: Gra kończy się remisem {score_0}-{score_1} po {num_rounds} rundach!
